reset.comment: Generic restore-to-default action label / a11y description (恢復 = restore). Used by the reset-settings dialog AND reused for the color-picker / slider reset-icon contentDescription on the theme + layout editors.

inputMode.comment: Settings row + sub-screen title for selecting the active input mode (mobile). The desktop General pane labels its TL / POJ picker inputScript instead.

displayLanguage.comment: Settings row + sub-screen title for selecting the app UI display language (orthogonal to the input mode). Most option labels are endonyms (own-script, not i18n keys); the Automatic option uses displayLanguageAutomatic.

displayLanguageAutomatic.comment: Display-language picker option that follows the OS/device language (ja->日本語, zh->漢字, else->English). Unlike the other rows this is a translated label, not an endonym.

pojMode.comment: Input-mode option: Pe̍h-ōe-jī (POJ) romanization. Also the iOS smartbar input-mode button a11y label (extension surface). Also the Pe̍h-ōe-jī settings section header (pojSettingsSectionTitle merged 2026-09-20).

tlMode.comment: Input-mode option: Tâi-lô (TL) romanization. Also the iOS smartbar input-mode button a11y label (extension surface).

englishMode.comment: Input-mode option: English keyboard. Also the iOS smartbar input-mode button a11y label (extension surface), and the Windows mode-flash label when a Shift tap switches to English input.

taigiMode.comment: Windows mode-flash label when a Shift tap switches back from English to Taigi input. Pairs with englishMode.

tpsMode.comment: Input-mode option: Taiwanese Phonetic Symbols (TPS). Also the iOS smartbar input-mode button a11y label (extension surface). Also the TPS settings section header and the layout page's TPS section header (tpsSettingsSectionTitle / layout.taigiPhonetic merged 2026-09-20).

candidateDisplayMode.comment: Picker label: how a candidate cell renders the (Hanji, romanization) pair — side by side (today) or romanization only. Host settings + iOS/Android in-keyboard settings overlay; desktop appearance pane.

candidateDisplayModeSideBySide.comment: Picker value (default): cell shows hanji and romanization as primary + secondary; the 文/A key decides which leads.

values.ja: 漢字とローマ字の対応

candidateDisplayModeCombined.comment: Picker value: cell shows hanji and romanization as ONE label (Hanji romanization); committing writes the hanji; the 文/A key is inert. TL/POJ only.

candidateDisplayModeRomanOnly.comment: Picker value: cell shows the romanization only; committing writes the romanization; TL/POJ only.

outputBothScripts.comment: Toggle label: annotate committed text with the other script in brackets.

inputScript.comment: Desktop General pane: label of the TL / POJ picker (USER 2026-09-18: "input/output script"), paired with outputScript below. Mobile keeps inputMode (Input Mode) — its picker also holds TPS.

outputScript.comment: Desktop General pane: label of the Hanji / romanization picker — which script a commit writes, the same stored swap the backtick shortcut flips. Paired with inputScript above.

outputScriptHanji.comment: Picker value (default): commit writes the Hanji; the romanization is the subtitle.

outputScriptRoman.comment: Picker value: commit writes the romanization; the Hanji is the subtitle.

hyphenlessRoman.comment: Toggle label: render candidate / committed romanization without the dictionary's inter-syllable hyphen, neutral-tone -- as · (tâi-uân → tâiuân, hōo--guá → hōo·guá). All four platforms, host settings only.

hyphenlessRomanInfo.comment: Help text for the No Hyphens toggle (mobile host app).

values.hanji: 候選詞佮送出的羅馬字無連字符（tâi-uân → tâiuân），輕聲記號 -- 改用 ·（hōo--guá → hōo·guá）。你家己拍的連字符無影響。
values.tailo: Hāu-suán sû kah sàng-tshut ê lô-má-jī bô liân-jī-hû (tâi-uân → tâiuân), khin-siann kì-hō -- kái iōng · (hōo--guá → hōo·guá). Lí ka-kī phah ê liân-jī-hû bô íng-hióng.
values.poj: Hāu-soán sû kah sàng-chhut ê lô-má-jī bô liân-jī-hû (tâi-oân → tâioân), khin-siaⁿ kì-hō -- kái iōng · (hō͘--goá → hō͘·goá). Lí ka-kī phah ê liân-jī-hû bô éng-hióng.
values.en: Shows and commits romanization without hyphens between syllables (tâi-uân → tâiuân); the neutral-tone marker -- becomes · (hōo--guá → hōo·guá). Hyphens you type yourself are unaffected.
values.ja: 候補と確定するローマ字から音節間のハイフンを省きます（tâi-uân → tâiuân）。軽声記号 -- は · になります（hōo--guá → hōo·guá）。自分で入力したハイフンは変わりません。

candidateWindow.comment: Toggle label on the desktop General pane: show the candidate window at all. Off = no window, Space / Enter write the typed romanization (S33).

values.ja: 候補ウィンドウを表示

literalRomanCandidate.comment: Toggle label: show what is being typed as the first candidate in the strip (§34 literal-roman candidate). All four platforms.

values.tailo: Tng-teh phah ê jī khǹg tē-it ê
values.poj: Tng-teh phah ê jī khǹg tē-it ê
values.ja: 入力中の文字を先頭に表示

literalRomanCandidateInfo.comment: Help text for the Show Typed Text First toggle.

values.hanji: 候選詞列第一格顯示你拍 ê 羅馬字，點揤抑是揤 Enter 送出。關閉了後干焦會當用 Enter 送出。
values.tailo: Hāu-suán sû lia̍t tē-it keh hián-sī lí phah ê lô-má-jī, tiám-tshi̍h ah-sī tshi̍h Enter sàng-tshut. Kuainn--khí-lâi liáu-āu kan-ta ē-tàng iōng Enter sàng-tshut.
values.poj: Hāu-soán sû lia̍t tē-it keh hián-sī lí phah ê lô-má-jī, tiám-chhi̍h ah-sī chhi̍h Enter sàng-chhut. Koaiⁿ--khí-lâi liáu-āu kan-ta ē-tàng iōng Enter sàng-chhut.
values.en: Shows what you typed in the first slot of the candidate bar; tap it or press Enter to commit. When off, only Enter commits it.
values.ja: 入力したローマ字を候補バーの先頭に表示し、タップか Enter で確定できます。オフの場合は Enter でのみ確定できます。

autoCapitalization.comment: Toggle label: automatic capitalization in English mode.

toneInputScheme.comment: Picker label on the desktop General pane: which keys type a tone (Standard = digits, Telex = letters); the candidate-slot keys follow from the choice.

toneSchemeStandard.comment: toneInputScheme option: digits 1-9 type the tone, the bare letters q w d f z x v y ; pick a candidate. Named after what the user types rather than 標準 (USER 2026-09-09) — beside Telex, "standard" says which is the default, not which keys carry the tone.

toneSchemeTelex.comment: toneInputScheme option: the letters v y d w x q type the tone, digits 1-9 pick a candidate. A scheme name, kept as-is in every language. Also the title over the floating Telex guide's key table — the scheme's own name, nothing else (USER 2026-09-0x; desktop.telexGuideTitle merged 2026-09-20).

autoSpace.comment: Toggle label: auto-insert a space after committing a word.

toolbarAutoCollapse.comment: Toggle label: automatically collapse the candidate toolbar after selecting a word.

values.hanji: 選字後自動收合工具列
values.tailo: Suán jī liáu-āu tsū-tōng siu-ha̍p kang-khū-lia̍t
values.poj: Soán jī liáu-āu chū-tōng siu-ha̍p kang-khū-lia̍t
values.ja: 候補選択後にツールバーを折りたたむ

toolbarAutoCollapseInfo.comment: Help text for the auto-hide-toolbar toggle.

values.hanji: 選字了後工具列會自動合起來，予齒盤面頂空間較大。
values.tailo: Suán jī liáu-āu kang-khū-lia̍t huē tsū-tōng ha̍p--khí-lâi, hōo khí-puânn bīn-tíng khang-king khah-tōa.
values.poj: Soán jī liáu-āu kang-khū-lia̍t hōe chū-tōng ha̍p--khí-lâi, hō͘ khí-pôaⁿ bīn-téng khang-keng khah-tōa.
values.en: After you pick a word, the toolbar collapses automatically to give the keyboard more room.
values.ja: 単語を選ぶとツールバーが自動的に閉じ、キーボードの表示領域が広くなります。

globeKey.comment: Toggle label: show the globe / keyboard-switch key.

globeKeyInfo.comment: Help text for the globe-key toggle.

values.hanji: 佇齒盤面頂加 1 粒地球揤鈕，揤著會使切換去其他齒盤。
values.tailo: Tī khí-puânn bīn-tíng ka 1 lia̍p tuē-kiû tshi̍h-liú, tshi̍h tio̍h ē-sái tshiat-uānn khì kî-thann khí-puânn.
values.poj: Tī khí-pôaⁿ bīn-téng ka 1 lia̍p tōe-kiû chhi̍h-liú, chhi̍h tio̍h ē-sái chhiat-ōaⁿ khì kî-thaⁿ khí-pôaⁿ.
values.en: Adds a globe key to the keyboard; tap it to switch to another keyboard.
values.ja: キーボードに地球儀キーを追加します。タップすると他のキーボードに切り替えられます。

feedbackSectionTitle.comment: Section header for key-press feedback settings.

doubleTapOO.comment: Toggle label: double-tap oo composes o͘ (POJ).

values.ja: oo を続けて入力 → o͘

doubleTapNN.comment: Toggle label: double-tap nn composes ⁿ (POJ nasal).

values.ja: nn を続けて入力 → ⁿ

nasalMarkerUppercase.comment: Toggle label: the POJ nasal marker follows the case of the letters before it (SIÂᴺ); off, it is always ⁿ (SIÂⁿ). Default ON. All four platforms, host settings only.

values.hanji: 大本字時 ⁿ 轉做 ᴺ
values.tailo: Tuā-pún-jī sî ⁿ tsuán tsò ᴺ
values.poj: Tōa-pún-jī sî ⁿ choán chò ᴺ
values.ja: 大文字では ⁿ を ᴺ に

nasalMarkerUppercaseInfo.comment: Help text for the ⁿ becomes ᴺ in capitals toggle (mobile host app).

values.hanji: 拍大本字的時陣，鼻音記號 ⁿ 嘛寫做大本字 ᴺ（SIÂᴺ）。關掉了後永遠寫小本字 ⁿ（SIÂⁿ）。
values.tailo: Phah tuā-pún-jī ê sî-tsūn, phīnn-im kì-hō ⁿ mā siá tsò tuā-pún-jī ᴺ (SIÂᴺ). Kuainn tiāu liáu-āu íng-uán siá sió-pún-jī ⁿ (SIÂⁿ).
values.poj: Phah tōa-pún-jī ê sî-chūn, phīⁿ-im kì-hō ⁿ mā siá chò tōa-pún-jī ᴺ (SIÂᴺ). Koaiⁿ tiāu liáu-āu éng-oán siá sió-pún-jī ⁿ (SIÂⁿ).
values.en: When you type in capitals, the nasal marker ⁿ is written as its capital ᴺ (SIÂᴺ). Off, it is always ⁿ (SIÂⁿ).
values.ja: 大文字で入力すると鼻音記号 ⁿ も大文字の ᴺ になります（SIÂᴺ）。オフにすると常に ⁿ になります（SIÂⁿ）。

tpsOrMapsToER.comment: Toggle label: render TL 'or' final as TPS ㄜ.

values.ja: or を ㄜ に対応

tpsOrMapsToERInfo.comment: Help text for the or→ㄜ toggle.

values.hanji: 開啟時 or 顯示做 ㄜ，關閉時顯示做 ㄛ。袂影響揣詞結果。
values.tailo: Phah-khui sî or hián-sī tsò ㄜ, kuainn--khí-lâi sî hián-sī tsò ㄛ. Buē íng-hióng tshuē sû kiat-kó.
values.poj: Phah-khui sî or hián-sī chò ㄜ, koaiⁿ--khí-lâi sî hián-sī chò ㄛ. Bōe éng-hióng chhōe sû kiat-kó.
values.en: When on, 'or' appears as ㄜ; when off, as ㄛ. Search results are unaffected.
values.ja: オンでは「or」を ㄜ、オフでは ㄛ と表示します。検索結果には影響しません。

resetSettings.comment: Destructive action row + dialog title: reset all settings and delete frequency/association records; custom words are preserved.

values.ja: 設定と利用記録をリセット

resetSettingsMessage.comment: Confirmation-dialog body for resetting settings and deleting frequency/association records; explicitly states that custom words are preserved.

values.hanji: 這會恢復所有設定，嘛會刪除詞頻佮詞關聯紀錄。自訂詞會保留。敢欲繼續？
values.tailo: Tse ē hue-ho̍k sóo-iú siat-tīng, mā ē san-tû sû pîn kah sû kuan-liân kì-lio̍k. Tsū-tīng-sû ē pó-liû. Kám beh kè-sio̍k?
values.poj: Che ē hoe-ho̍k só͘-iú siat-tēng, mā ē san-tû sû pîn kah sû koan-liân kì-lio̍k. Chū-tēng-sû ē pó-liû. Kám beh kè-sio̍k?
values.en: This resets all settings and deletes frequency and association records. Custom words are kept. Continue?
values.ja: すべての設定をリセットし、単語頻度と単語連携の記録を削除します。カスタム単語は保持されます。続けますか？

resetSuccess.comment: Toast shown after settings were reset successfully.

values.ja: 設定をリセットしました

resetFailed.comment: Toast shown when resetting settings fails.

values.en: Failed to reset settings. Please try again.
values.ja: 設定のリセットに失敗しました。もう一度お試しください。

noEmailApp.comment: Toast shown when no email app is available to send the bug report.

values.ja: メールアプリが見つかりません

diagnosticCopy.comment: Action row: copy device diagnostic info to clipboard.

values.ja: デバイス情報をコピー

diagnosticCopied.comment: Toast confirming diagnostic info was copied.

diagnosticShare.comment: Action row: share device diagnostic info via the share sheet.

diagnosticEmail.comment: Action row: email a bug report with diagnostic info attached.

openApp.comment: Keyboard-overlay button linking to the host app's full settings screen.
